# How to update a status

Order statuses can be updated through several different methods depending on your workflow. This article explains each method and the automation that occurs when a status changes.

## Manual Status Update

The most common way to update an order status is directly from the Orders page. Click on an order to open it, then use the status dropdown to select the new status.

When you manually set an order to **Ready**, **Shipped**, or **Completed**, all incomplete jobs associated with that order are automatically marked as **Completed**. This saves you from having to update each job individually.

## Automatic Update via Job Completion

When all jobs on an order are marked as **Completed** (either individually or in bulk), the order status automatically changes to **Ready**. This transition happens instantly and does not trigger any customer notifications.

This is the recommended workflow for production teams — focus on completing jobs as they are finished, and the order status will update itself.

## Shipping Label Purchase

When a shipping label is purchased through the Ship Desk, the order status is automatically set to **Shipped**. A tracking URL is also saved against the order record.

If customer notifications are enabled for the **Shipped** trigger, an email and/or SMS will be sent automatically at this point.

## API Integration

External systems can update order statuses via the OrderHub API using the **Update Order Status** endpoint. The same automation rules apply — setting a status to **Ready**, **Shipped**, or **Completed** through the API will automatically complete all associated jobs.

API status updates do not trigger customer notifications directly. Notifications are managed separately through the platform's notification settings.

## Pixfizz Integration

For orders originating from Pixfizz, status updates are synchronised back to the Pixfizz platform:

- **Completed** — When manually marking an order as Completed, you can choose whether to send the customer a notification via the Pixfizz platform. A tracking URL can also be included.
- **Shipped** — When a shipping label is purchased, the Shipped status and tracking URL are automatically sent to Pixfizz. If OrderHub is already handling shipped notifications (email/SMS), the Pixfizz customer notification is suppressed to avoid duplicates.

Inbound status changes from Pixfizz (e.g. cancellations) are handled automatically via the webhook integration.

## POS Integration

Orders created through a POS integration (Square, Shopify, Lightspeed) follow the same status rules as any other order. Status updates are managed within OrderHub and are not synchronised back to the POS system.

## Summary of Automation Rules

| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| All jobs completed | Order → **Ready** |
| Order set to Ready / Shipped / Completed | All jobs → **Completed** |
| Shipping label purchased | Order → **Shipped** + notification sent |
| API status update | Same job automation, no notifications |
| Pixfizz order completed | Optional notification to customer |
| Pixfizz order shipped | Auto-notification (unless OrderHub handles it) |
